create_STFT_module: create an STFT module with custom filter_length, hop_length, win_length, and window parameters
run_STFT_transform: run the transform method on audio input data to extract magnitude and phase spectrograms
run_STFT_inverse: run the inverse method on magnitude and phase tensors to reconstruct audio waveforms
run_STFT_forward: run the forward method to perform a full STFT transform and reconstruction round-trip
review_STFT_class: review the STFT class to understand how it uses conv1d for Fourier transforms and conv_transpose1d for inversion
